Dia Mirza’s Diwali Controversy & India’s Outrage Culture | Punit Pania | Cyrus Says
Welcome to Cyrus Says!
A Diwali special with Punit Pania. What could possibly go wrong?
Punit joins Cyrus Broacha on Cock & Bull to discuss Dia Mirza’s Diwali campaign controversy, Mumbai’s disappearing roads, expensive flights and the endless frustrations of being middle class.
Between the political rants, Punit refuses to accept zodiac signs as an excuse for bad behaviour, Cyrus passionately defends French fries, and a question about dating produces a revelation: “I’m the last Pania. I’m the season finale.”
